open_points.subject: TrialExecution value output above stored-value ceiling
open_points.question: What outcome is recorded when a sandbox execution succeeds and its total output is within `output_bytes`, but one value output exceeds `stored_value_bytes_max` and therefore cannot be stored as the M07 StoredValue?
options: Treat the storage refusal as `internal_error` and write no TrialExecution
open_points.default_guess: Record the TrialExecution as `contract_violation` with `value_too_large`, matching real function executions.

open_points.subject: Function output validation during a run
open_points.text: `module:sandbox` ... returns one outcome ... and, on success, outputs that fit the output ports. / On success it validates each output against the source port ... a failure against the source port concludes this node ... `contract_violation`.
open_points.question: Does `module:sandbox` own and decide source-port output validation, or can `module:runs` receive a successful sandbox result and independently turn a source-port mismatch into `contract_violation`?
options: Sandbox alone decides source-port conformance; runs validates only delivery to target ports
Runs owns source-port validation after sandbox success
Both validate, with a specified precedence if their results differ
open_points.default_guess: Sandbox alone decides source-port conformance; runs validates delivery to target ports.

open_points.subject: Disclosure class of file outputs in TrialExecution M07
open_points.text: `outputs`: ... for a `file` port only its facts — digest, size and media type, no bytes and never a StoredValue / records a file output by its facts only (M07), each with the highest class of the case's inputs
open_points.question: Is the disclosure class stored in each trial file-output fact, despite M07 limiting those facts to digest, size and media type, or is it only derived from the trial inputs when read?
options: Add disclosure class to each trial file-output fact
Keep M07 unchanged and derive the class from the case inputs
Represent the file output as a StoredValue carrying the class
open_points.default_guess: Keep M07 unchanged and derive the class from the case inputs.
